system.description: • Effect: Once per round, when you hit a creature that cannot see you with a light or finesse melee weapon, multiply the weapon's damage dice (double at 1st level, rising to sextuple at 20th: see the Rogue Progression Table).

activities.name: Back Attack
activities.text: Once per round, when you hit a creature that cannot see you with a light or finesse melee weapon, multiply the weapon's damage dice by {1:2, 5:3, 9:4, 14:5, 20:6}.

rules.value: Back Attack: multiply the weapon's damage dice by {1:2, 5:3, 9:4, 14:5, 20:6}.
